data.name: Candy Girl!! Dreams Forever
data.detailed_description:
A narrative game about childhood, dreams, and memories that insist on remaining.

Candy Girl!! Dreams Forever is an atmospheric storytelling experience inspired by childhood imagination and nostalgia. The story follows a girl trapped in an excessively gentle world: pastel colors, comforting silence, and a constant sense of calm—too calm.

What begins as a comforting dream gradually reveals something strange. There is loneliness. There are fragmented memories. And there is the unsettling feeling that the Girl is not alone… even without realizing it.

In this soft and deceptively perfect world, the player explores environments, observes details, and learns primarily through the surrounding space. The narrative unfolds subtly, allowing the player to connect past, present, and future through silent discoveries.

An imaginary journey

  • Explore a world that blends dreams and reality.

  • Discover memories that connect the past to the future.

  • Learn by observing the environment, the silences, and small gestures.

  • The Girl’s imagination shapes the world around her.

Escape or hope

  • Seek answers while trying to escape something that haunts you.

  • Get to know the Girl and the people who marked her life.

  • Pay attention to words, decisions, and actions—everything matters.

  • The world isn't just pinky; it can have meaning.

Growing up

  • Look for clues, talk to people, and run when necessary to survive.

  • Throughout her journey, the Girl comes to understand her loved ones better.

  • The lessons she learns shape the future that awaits her.

  • Help the Girl find her Grandma — someone essential for her to grow up without fear and face reality.

Candy Girl!! Dreams Forever is a short, sensitive, and melancholic story about growing up, remembering, and accepting that not every dream can last forever.

Regarding gameplay streaming and video content:

Whether you are an individual or a corporation, commercial or non-commercial, you may freely stream and upload videos of the game without prior notice, as long as you do not violate any prohibited rules.

If possible, we would appreciate it if you include the title of the work in your video title.

Credits:

Trailer background music: end of the day – Kouichi Morita.
Fonts used in the trailer: Zing Script Rust Semi Bold and Kurale.
Sound effects: RPG Maker MZ and Maou Audio.

Some sound effects were obtained for free from Pixabay Sound Effect and Springin under a license that allows commercial use.

Other sound effects by Pond5.

Main Menu Theme Song: "12th Story: Koropokkuru Squad and Big Friends" - By: Kontodoufe.

Disable and activable Mouse RPG Maker MV - MZ by EroiK StyLeR.

CTB_HideMenuStatusWindow by ct_bolt.

Paper texture by .

Special thanks to Rlyeh.
